name: nats-manager-1.0.0
description: NATS server monitoring and JetStream management — query health, inspect streams/consumers, view connections, and manage the nervous system

tools.name: nats_health
tools.description: Get NATS server health including uptime, CPU, memory, connections, subscriptions, messages in/out rates. The quick pulse-check for the nervous system.

tools.name: nats_connections
tools.description: List all active NATS connections with client name, IP, subscriptions, and message rates. Shows who's connected to the nervous system.

tools.name: nats_streams
tools.description: List all JetStream streams with message counts, storage size, consumer counts, and config. The overview of all persistent data channels.

tools.name: nats_stream_detail
tools.description: Get detailed info about a specific JetStream stream including config, state, subjects, and consumer list.

tools.name: nats_consumers
tools.description: List all consumers on a JetStream stream with delivery status, ack pending, and last activity.

stream.description: Stream name to list consumers for

tools.name: nats_subscriptions
tools.description: List all active subscriptions across the server. Shows what subjects are being listened to and by whom.

test_subject.description: Optional: filter to subscriptions matching this subject pattern

tools.name: nats_stream_create
tools.description: Create a new JetStream stream for persistent message storage. Use for setting up new event channels.

max_age_hours.description: Max message retention in hours (default: 168 = 7 days)

tools.name: nats_stream_purge
tools.description: Purge all messages from a JetStream stream. Use with caution — data is permanently deleted.
